recruiter.title: I turn complex products into clear, usable
recruiter.text: Product designer with 5+ years in B2B SaaS, Web3, marketplaces and consumer apps. End to end, from research and roadmap to design systems and handoff. Based in Barcelona, working remotely.

founder.title: Your product is complex. Your users shouldn't
founder.text: I gather what every team needs, decide what matters first and turn it into a roadmap and a system your team can build on. Carbon markets, Web3 auctions, B2B portals: dense by nature, clear by design.

engineer.title: Designs that
engineer.text: Variables, components, states and edge cases come with the handoff. I write HTML, CSS and React, and build design systems with Claude Code and Figma MCP.

paragraphs: I design web and mobile products for complex domains: B2B SaaS, marketplaces, Web3 platforms and AI tools. The focus is always the same: take something technically dense and make it feel obvious to the person using it.
Outside of work I customise clothes, and I've travelled to 36 countries. Both keep shaping how I think about people, behaviour and detail.
